overloads.semanticRole: Returns a numeric constant identifying which kind of 4D environment (desktop, remote, server, volume desktop, tool4d) the calling process is running under.

constraints: The returned Integer is one of the predefined Application type constants: 4D Local mode=0, 4D Volume desktop=1, 4D Desktop=3, 4D Remote mode=4, 4D Server=5, tool4d=6 (values 2 and 7+ unused/reserved as of this doc snapshot).
